entries.text: Most flights between Europe and North America face delays today.

entries.text: Transatlantic flights are forced to change routes and carry extra fuel in case of delay.

entries.raw: **In Great Britain, at least 29 flights from [[London Stansted Airport]] to [[Spain]]/[[Portugal]]/[[Canary Islands]], at least seven flights from [[London Gatwick Airport]] to [[Alicante]], [[Barcelona]], [[Madrid]] and [[Portugal]], and at least one flight from [[London Heathrow Airport]] to [[A Coruña|La Coruña]] are cancelled.
